sharedRules.name: Forward Defence
sharedRules.description: Jaguar 1 and Jaguar 2 Jagdpanzer Zugs can be placed on table in missions with Deep Reserves in addition to the normal limit of one Tank Unit with Front Armour 4 or more, or one Aircraft Unit.

sharedRules.name: Milan Mount
sharedRules.description: Milan missile teams may fire while Mounted as a Passenger in a transport with a Milan Mount, using the Optional Milan Missile weapons line.

sharedRules.name: Radar (Gepard)
sharedRules.description:
When shooting at Aircraft, Vehicles equipped with Radar do not suffer the usual +1 penalty To Hit for range over 16" / 40cm and extend their range to:
- 40" / 100cm for a Gepard
